en-US.author: Microsoft Corporation
en-US.description: A feature of Windows that allows you to run a Linux environment on your Windows machine, without the need for a separate virtual machine or dual booting.
en-US.installationNotes: If the virtual machine platform Windows optional feature was enabled, a restart is required for WSL to function properly.
en-US.longDescription: Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) is a feature of Windows that allows you to run a Linux environment on your Windows machine, without the need for a separate virtual machine or dual booting. WSL is designed to provide a seamless and productive experience for developers who want to use both Windows and Linux at the same time.
en-US.name: Windows Subsystem for Linux
en-US.releaseNotes:

- Match console detach sequence for full UTF-16 characters by @ggarzia-MSFT in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/41960

- Fix ring buffer handling by @chemwolf6922 in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42028
- Fix consomme falling back to none when ipv6 is disabled with a dual stack host by @chemwolf6922 in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42026

- Add exec events to WSLC by @beena352 in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/41999
- Default wslc image import to the latest tag when no tag is given by @ggarzia-MSFT in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42065

- Fix warning handle duplication crashes by @dkbennett in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42047
- Fix deadlock on container --rm restart logic by @kvega005 in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42067
- Always capture guest state if the tests time out by @OneBlue in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42066
- Publish WSLC init process control after WSLCProcess construction by @ggarzia-MSFT in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42069
- Release COMImplClass caller registration before dropping impl reference by @ggarzia-MSFT in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42072

- Add missing user impersonation logic on various filesystem operations by @OneBlue in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42048
- Fix: resolve drive letter relative to the client pwd instead of the service by @chemwolf6922 in https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/pull/42076
